claim: The public local core must remain MIT and must not be relicensed restrictively after adoption.
falsifier: Any public release or policy moves already-public local-core capabilities behind a restrictive license or paid gate.
next_action: Keep license boundary visible before any public release or pricing copy.

claim: Capabilities necessary for the local core to feel legitimate must stay in the public core; monetization must sell additive convenience, maintenance, cloud, team, enterprise, compliance, or support value.
falsifier: A pricing or packaging decision removes local risk classification, hooks, skills, adapters, or evidence machinery from the public core to force conversion.
next_action: Review each pricing and packaging change against R2 before launch.

falsifier: Any public offer, checkout text, FAQ, license, or launch post labels the cohort as lifetime.
next_action: Add naming lint to launch-copy review before sale-page work.
